name: Voxel block world
region: Sweden and the United States, then worldwide
summary: The world is a grid of 1 m cubes, each with a 16×16 pixel texture on its faces. Every house, room and hill is built block by block, with nearest-neighbour pixels and simple face light.

philosophy.core_thesis: If the world is a grid of equal blocks, anyone can build in it, and the grid itself becomes the style.
design_principles: Build every surface from cubes of 1 m on a 3D grid.
Texture each face with 16×16 px pixel art, scaled with no filter.
Light each face by its direction: top brightest, sides mid, bottom darkest.
Keep characters blocky: a body of rectangular boxes.
Use clear, saturated material colours: grass green, dirt brown, stone grey.
Let builds read as stacked blocks; avoid hiding the grid.

projection_and_camera.camera: Free first-person, or third-person behind the player.
projection_and_camera.framing: Eye level at 1.6 blocks; wide views over hills of blocks.

geometry.primitive: A cube voxel of 1 m on each side.
geometry.budget: Chunks of 16×16 columns; a view of hundreds of thousands of blocks.
geometry.edge_rule: Hard 90° edges; every edge is on the grid.
geometry.proportion: A character is 1.8 blocks high and 0.6 wide; a door is 1 by 2 blocks.

surface.texture_rule: A 16×16 px tile for each material face, with simple noise in pixel art.
surface.material_model: No material model; face light and smooth ambient occlusion only.

palette.strategy: Natural, saturated material colours; each block is one recognisable material.
palette.colour_depth: 24 bits, used in small pixel palettes

lighting.model: Light levels from 0 to 15 that spread block by block from the sky and torches.
lighting.shadows: Darker blocks under cover; no sharp cast shadows by default.
lighting.time_of_day: A full day cycle with a square sun and moon.

world_and_space.scale: 1 block = 1 m; ceilings of 3 blocks are common.
world_and_space.interiors: Rooms built from planks and stone with block furniture.
world_and_space.exteriors: Villages of block houses on blocky hills, paths of gravel blocks.
world_and_space.threshold: A 1×2 door block opens with no break.

principles.rule: Make a door 1 block wide and 2 blocks high for a figure 1.8 blocks high.
Use 2 layers: sky light and torch light.

interface.placement: A bar of item slots at the bottom centre, about 5% of the screen.
interface.type_and_icons: A pixel font and pixel-art item icons.
interface.diegesis: On top; signs in the world are blocks.

emotion.target_response: Open creative play: the viewer sees a world that invites them to build.

avoid_when: The brief needs curves or real materials.

modifiers.how: Keep the cubes; use flat pastel faces and an isometric camera.
Collapse to a 2D side view on an 8×8 tile grid.
